{{Quote|Darth Drear wrote that he had found an elixir for staving off death itself, the ingredients of which he recorded in the Holocron&mdash;including, of course, your beloved orchid. The mixture was complete in and of itself, with a single flaw&mdash; The inevitable dissolution of the tissue.|Darth Scabrous, to Hestizo Trace|<ref name="RH" />}}
'''Darth Drear''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of [[Human/Legends|Human]] or [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] descent who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] around [[4645 BBY]]. He founded a [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Odacer-Faustin]] and worked his [[Sith acolyte/Legends|students]] to [[Death/Legends|death]] as they labored in the construction of the [[Sith academy|academy]]. Beneath the [[Odacer-Faustin academy library|academy library]], Drear built a [[Odacer-Faustin Sith temple|temple]], where he practiced [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] and searched for a pathway to [[Immortality/Legends|immortality]]. He developed an [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|elixir]] to fulfill his goal, effectively creating a disease that turned all those infected into [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]], knowledge he recorded into a [[Darth Drear's holocron|holocron]]. Before Drear could successfully implement the final stage of his project, however, he succumbed to the effects of the disease and died.

==Biography==
{{Quote|This library is the oldest part of the academy, older even than the tower itself. It was constructed over a thousand years ago by a Sith Lord named Darth Drear. He founded the academy, back when the planet itself was young.|Darth Scabrous|<ref name="RH" />}}
[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Drear was a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="RH" /> of [[Human/Legends|Human]] or [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] descent<ref name="Species" /> who held the title of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]<ref name="RH" /> in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Affiliation" /> Circa [[4645 BBY]], he founded a [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith academy]] on the [[Water/Legends|snow]]-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Odacer-Faustin]]. Drear used the initial [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|students]] at his [[Sith academy|academy]] as laborers, tasking them with constructing chambers and corridors using only [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Moving [[Metric ton/Legends|tons]] of ice and snow proved too much of a strain on many of the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentices]], but Drear saw to it that they worked until their exhaustion [[Death/Legends|killed]] them. When the building efforts were completed, the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] populated the chambers with his personal collection of "specimens."<ref name="RH" />

Drear also partook in construction, crafting himself a hidden [[Odacer-Faustin Sith temple|Sith temple]] located beneath the academy's [[Odacer-Faustin academy library|library]]. In this private fortress, its walls engraved with his plans for the destruction of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], he experimented in [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]]. Over [[Time/Legends|time]], he searched for a way to achieve [[Immortality/Legends|immortality]] and used the rare [[Murakami orchid]] to produce a formula that would help him achieve his goal. Drear's efforts produced an [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|elixir]] that, when consumed, shut down the body before reanimating it as a homicidal [[Zombie/Legends|zombie]]. The pathway to eternal life, however, could only be completed once the user ate the still-beating [[Heart/Legends|heart]] of a strong [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]; the [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]] found in the [[Blood/Legends|blood]] in the heart were enough to halt the decaying process induced by the elixir and prevent the user from devolving into a mindless, undead creature. Drear stored the knowledge of the formula in a [[Darth Drear's holocron|Sith holocron]] before moving to complete his plans and cheat death.<ref name="RH" />

The Sith Lord dispatched underlings to kidnap a [[Unidentified kidnapped Jedi|Jedi]] on a nearby world and prepared to utilize the Force-user in the final stage of the process. Furthermore, Drear had a [[Darth Drear's Sith sword|sword]] fashioned exclusively for the procedure of cutting out the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] heart. When the time came, Drear ingested the elixir, but his plans for immortality were foiled when it was realized that the captured Jedi possessed an insufficient midi-chlorian count to keep the Sith Lord alive. Deprived of his triumph, Drear perished as a result of the disease he had engineered to grant eternal life.<ref name="RH" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|This blade belonged to Darth Drear. It was forged exclusively for him, to ensure his immortality. So today, in accordance with his legacy, I will use it to slice out your living heart, and devour it while you watch.|Darth Scabrous, to Hestizo Trace|<ref name="RH" />}}
Although Drear died, the knowledge of his elixir did not die with him. Safely stored away in his [[Sith holocron/Legends|holocron]], the formula was kept hidden until the Sith Lord [[Darth Scabrous]] discovered the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] and its contents around [[3645 BBY]], during his tenure as headmaster of Drear's academy. Scabrous sought to succeed where Drear had not, but his experimentation with the elixir ultimately leaked out, turning the entire faculty and student body of the Odacer-Faustin academy into zombies. Despite his perseverance, Scabrous's own bid for immortality ended in failure when he was [[Duel in the Odacer-Faustin Sith Temple|killed]] by Jedi [[Hestizo Trace]] in the final stage of the process.<ref name="RH" /> Thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] replicated Drear's elixir as a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]], which infected the entire crew of the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']].<ref name="DT">''[[Death Troopers]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|The ancient writings tell about how he used his first students as laborers. ''[&hellip;]'' It was thought that Drear worked the students until they died from exhaustion.|Darth Scabrous|<ref name="RH" />}}
As the founder of the Odacer-Faustin academy, Drear employed his first students as a work crew and forced them to labor in the construction of the academy's buildings. The strain produced from the repeated moving of snow and ice with the Force exhausted the acolytes, but Drear continued to push them until many died from fatigue. Although he relied on student labor for the majority of the construction effort, the Sith Lord single-handedly fashioned a secret [[Sith temple/Legends|temple]] for himself beneath the academy library, where he practiced the Sith ritual ceremonies of old. It was in the Sith temple that Drear experimented with pathways to immortality, eventually developing a successful formula. His search for eternal life ultimately killed him, however, as he was unable to complete the process before the elixir's effects overtook him.<ref name="RH" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|&hellip;Drear built himself a secret temple, where he practiced the rituals and rites of the ancients, encoded in the Sith Holocron.|Darth Scabrous|<ref name="RH" />}}
Within his subterranean temple, Drear practiced the rites of Sith alchemy, which were stored within a Sith holocron. His alchemical practices, which he in turn also stored in the holocron, led him to develop an elixir that would enable him to cheat death, had he not perished during the final stage of the experiment. Drear possessed a [[Sith sword]], specially made for use in his quest for immortality.<ref name="RH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Drear was first mentioned in author [[Joe Schreiber]]'s [[2010]] novel, [[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']].<ref name="RH" />
